tasks.title: Establish neutral benchmark package and calibrated substrate
expectedOutputs: A standalone @exharness/benchmark workspace package owns substrate-independent experiment registration, attempt/evidence/accounting and audit contracts without importing ExHarness product runtime packages.

A pinned Harbor adapter and deterministic calibration workload prove fresh reset, independent verification, artifact extraction, evidence reopening and orthogonal failure/accounting semantics before any harness-value claim.

The retired scripts/delivery/baseline Direct/Core value-study implementation is removed from current benchmark execution paths after replacement calibration passes; Git history retains historical evidence.
BB-065 establishes benchmark trustworthiness only. Direct-versus-ExHarness harness economics, component attribution and product-value conclusions remain downstream.

tasks.title: Integrate a real coding-agent execution strategy
expectedOutputs: A real agent edits the declared fixture through runtimeAdapter.dispatch and reports exact execution and source evidence.
Fresh-process recover reuses the same attempt/session or reports an explicit unresolved outcome; it cannot silently create a second semantic attempt.
Pinned strategy/config and authorized scope survive policy change, timeout and cancellation; runtime success never self-accepts delivery.

tasks.title: Enforce bounded workspace and tool capabilities
expectedOutputs: Forbidden file, cross-workspace and credential access fail under the selected sandbox threat model, including indirect tool calls.
Time/token/cost ceilings stop further dispatch and preserve a recoverable outcome; secrets are absent from persisted traces.
Untrusted repository/MCP content cannot grant tools, change authorized domains or bypass approval for configured protected operations.

tasks.title: Connect real repository changes to CI and review evidence
expectedOutputs: The candidate records base SHA, exact resulting commit/tree, changed files and CI run identities from the real provider.
A deliberate failing check returns bounded repair; stale checks and unrelated branch updates cannot satisfy candidate acceptance.
Retry after lost provider acknowledgement discovers the existing change or blocks on ambiguity; it does not create duplicate review requests or bypass merge policy.

tasks.title: Prove first useful agent delivery through Oracle and independent QA
expectedOutputs: The real feature uses Oracle-resolved exact input refs, produces a real candidate and runs in an isolated preview whose release identity is recorded.
Independent QA observes functional behavior and rejects a seeded defect even when the producer says success.
At least three reset live runs and one kill/resume path have complete evidence, budgets and failure records; feasibility is reported separately from pilot value.

tasks.title: Deliver product from goal and partial artifacts across owned domains
expectedOutputs: Goal-only, requirements/design and existing-code seeds converge to the same declared acceptance semantics with actual product evidence.
FE and BE can progress independently where obligations allow; domain publication creates authorized obligations without selecting another domain's runtime.
Missing authoritative product decisions pause for the owner; current deployment/QA/completeness evidence is required for product outcome closure.

tasks.title: Prove requirement change and failure recovery on a live product
expectedOutputs: A real requirement change invalidates only affected outputs and drives the owning domains to a newly verified release.
Kill/resume and duplicate activation preserve attempt identity and one logical external publication.
An old worker and stale deployment observation cannot close changed work; unrelated accepted outputs remain current.

tasks.title: Make delivery runs observable recoverable and cost bounded
expectedOutputs: A fresh operator can explain blockers and inspect exact task/attempt/model/runtime/SCM identities without model-inferred provenance.
Cost and duration include failed/retried provider calls; missing usage is explicit and cannot appear as zero.
Backup/restore and process restart recover canonical runs; lost telemetry cannot grant or revoke product acceptance.

tasks.title: Ship an installable supported delivery profile
expectedOutputs: A fresh environment installs a pinned release and completes the reference delivery with documented configuration.
Health checks and actionable errors cover missing credentials, unsupported runtime and incompatible persisted state.
Upgrade and rollback exercises preserve or explicitly gate ongoing attempt compatibility; runbooks document support boundaries.

tasks.title: Measure delivery-harness value under a controlled benchmark program
expectedOutputs: Run a preregistered harness comparison with fixed model snapshot, task input, workspace, prompt contract, resource ceilings, artifact extraction and evaluator; include an external/public workload plus ExHarness delivery-lifecycle workloads and held-out tasks.

Report all attempts as a multidimensional profile: accepted quality, cost/tokens per accepted delivery, lead time, human active effort, repeated-run consistency, fault robustness and harness failure fingerprints; do not collapse the result into one opaque score.

Exercise delivery-specific scenarios including verifier rejection and repair, stale context, process kill/resume, session handoff, provider ambiguity, CI failure and dependency/currentness fencing so lifecycle value is measured separately from coding pass rate.
A failed or inconclusive preregistered gate yields an explicit no-go or follow-up scope; no value claim may be inferred from selected successful demonstrations.

tasks.title: Validate one useful HOW improvement on held-out delivery tasks
expectedOutputs: Select one HOW candidate from an observed benchmark failure fingerprint or ablation result, not from an architecture preference, and freeze product semantics plus resource ceilings before evaluation.
Evaluate the candidate on held-out tasks with the same model/harness benchmark contract and report paired quality-cost-latency-human-effort deltas plus new failure modes.
Independent evaluation supports PROMOTE or KEEP_BASELINE only from the preregistered evidence; acceptance semantics and producer-authored success claims cannot be changed after results.
Existing attempts remain pinned, new attempts use a promoted strategy only after authorization, and regression can trigger supported rollback.

tasks.title: Accept supported product release with independently reproducible value
expectedOutputs: All prerequisite feature evidence is delivered and the exact release reproduces supported entry, change, recovery, handoff and independent QA behavior.
A clean operator environment reproduces installation, a representative delivery and the benchmark protocol on the exact release; documentation states the supported harness/model/runtime profile.
Release evidence includes the multidimensional benchmark profile and known limitations, with no claim based solely on source merge, CI, agent success or a single aggregate benchmark score.

tasks.title: Research harness-isolation economics on shared benchmark kernel
expectedOutputs: DIRECT_CODEACT and CORE_SYNC are experiment-specific arm adapters over the delivered @exharness/benchmark kernel and calibrated substrate, not owners of generic runner/accounting/evidence infrastructure.
A fixed-factor protocol, cohort/repeat schedule and harness-economics reducer isolate synchronous harness effects while preserving every attempt and UNKNOWN/null provider observations.
BB-077 emits only comparison-specific metrics/reporting and a held-out handoff for BB-081; generic AttemptLedger/evidence/accounting/audit remain BB-065 ownership.
Worker execution remains blocked on BB-065 delivery even when research readiness converges.

No duplicate non-idempotent effects across restart/cancel/concurrent wakeup.
Explicit synchronous compatibility profile.

tasks.title: Research held-out harness profile acceptance and fault-ablation protocol
expectedOutputs: Define a held-out ablation matrix over the synchronous baseline and BB-078/079/080 capabilities so detached operations, cache-stable context and steering/recovery effects can be attributed separately under one fixed benchmark contract.

Predeclare repeated runs and fault injections for timeout/provider ambiguity, tool failure, process kill/restart, duplicate wakeup and cancellation; measure recovery success, duplicate effects, cost/latency and accepted quality together.
Define PROMOTE_ASYNC versus KEEP_SYNC_BASELINE from a Pareto/non-inferiority gate rather than pass rate alone, with complete attempt accounting and independent verification.
Revoke the prior READY premise and issue a fresh readiness binding only after this acceptance protocol is stable and compatible with the unified delivery benchmark program.

tasks.title: Define trusted objective supersession and research reset control
expectedOutputs: A typed objective-supersession contract binds exact old/new objective identities, rationale/evidence, target plan and downstream impact.
Trusted CI provides a dedicated supersession publication path while ordinary RESEARCH_SA candidates remain unable to redefine their own objective.
Supersession resets an unfinished target to DRAFT research with stale readiness/worker authority, claim and context removed while retaining historical provenance.
A separate BB-065 migration can use the delivered control to replace the obsolete value-study objective with neutral substrate calibration.

tasks.title: Research feedback lifecycle and cross-episode learning
expectedOutputs: Specify observation/context/finding/impact contracts with exact identity, provenance, uncertainty and missing-context behavior.
Specify application-owned disposition and ACTED/REJECTED/DEFERRED/SUPERSEDED response resolution, recovery and fresh IMPROVED/NO_CHANGE/REGRESSED/UNKNOWN outcomes.
Specify deduplicated cohort-based pattern proposals, counterevidence, systemic mechanism evidence and reinforcement without automatic escalation.
Define additive seams with Observer/Oracle/reconciliation/HOW evolution and neutral benchmark evidence, preserving existing accepted scopes.

Compare reuse and smallest native extension using verified primary evidence; produce exact package/file-level implementation plan, direct dependencies, negative cases and preregistered benchmark/eval protocol for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Implement grounded observation and context binding
expectedOutputs: Specify GROUNDED_OBSERVATION_V1 normalizing BB-058 causal facts and delivered execution identity with exact subject, attempt, runtime invocation and provider-event identity, evidence refs and MISSING_PROVENANCE, never inferring causal truth from narrative.
Specify OBSERVATION_CONTEXT_BINDING_V1 binding BB-064 ContextResolution identity, status, receipt and currentness with fail-closed classification of missing, stale, ambiguous or unverifiable context.
Specify GROUNDED_FINDING_INPUT_V1 as the only feedback-facing output, carrying grounding status, typed unresolved reasons and uncertainty without finding, disposition or authority fields.

Define additive seams consuming BB-058 and BB-064 only through a Worker-start delivered-export preflight, with explicit DELIVERED_TRUTH / PLANNED_CONTRACT / RESEARCH_DESIRED_STATE labels and no modification of their scope.
Produce an exact package/file-level implementation plan, direct dependencies, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Implement application-owned feedback episode lifecycle
expectedOutputs: Specify an immutable FeedbackEpisode whose finding and MEASURED or HYPOTHESIZED impact bind exact BB-084 GroundedFindingInput refs, scope key and contrary evidence; unresolved input cannot yield MEASURED impact or ACTED.

Specify application-owned ACTED/REJECTED/DEFERRED/SUPERSEDED responses with verified principal, expected-revision CAS, idempotent replay and crash recovery; observer, evaluator and provider cannot act as principal.
Specify fresh IMPROVED/NO_CHANGE/REGRESSED/UNKNOWN outcomes bound to a frozen outcome policy and explicit freshness identity newer than the response; UNKNOWN is never success.
Specify FeedbackResolution as the terminal lifecycle boundary with no cross-episode aggregation, optimizer, benchmark or promotion dependency.
Produce an exact package/file-level implementation plan, direct dependencies, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Implement evidence-gated self-improvement pipeline
expectedOutputs: Specify a deterministic cross-episode pattern projection over FeedbackResolution refs with deduplication, explicit cohort keys, retained contrary evidence, mechanism-gated SYSTEMIC classification and reinforcement as support metadata only.
Specify HOW_IMPROVEMENT_PROPOSAL_V1 binding pattern and cohort refs, baseline HOW ref+digest, one allowed HOW axis, optimizer identity and candidate digest with no accepted or promoted authority.

Specify the pinned standalone GEPA offline bridge with Node-owned benchmark reservation, crash reconciliation, cancellation accounting and hard pre-dispatch budget, reusing executed BB-083 probe evidence.

Specify the independent evaluation handoff: sealed final holdout, frozen metric policy and minEffect, paired baseline/candidate runs registered in @exharness/benchmark and BB-059 independent promotion, with critical regression and UNKNOWN never success.
Produce an exact package/file-level implementation plan, direct dependencies, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Fix Oracle facade budget accounting and typed provider failure
expectedOutputs: Specify facade budget accounting derived from actual materialization bytes, returned items and planner-reserved provider calls, with small budgets resolvable and over-budget results reported as BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.

Specify facade execution through the delivered retrievalPlanner.execute() so per-work reservations apply and provider failures become typed unresolved reasons with UNSATISFIED or PARTIAL status instead of thrown errors.
Specify preservation of planner and provider unresolved reasons, pre/post currentness fencing, durability reuse and Core injected-port behavior without contract changes.
Produce an exact file-level fix plan with regression tests reproducing every probe defect, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Productize authoritative snapshot-bound Context Graph
expectedOutputs: Specify deterministic snapshot-bound edge extraction for static ES-module imports/re-exports and declared structured JSON edges, with per-edge AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE provenance, file digest and typed out-of-scope boundary nodes.
Specify a graphClient.traverse implementation over the delivered createContextGraphProvider seam with bounded hop/item/byte limits, deterministic ordering and exact path provenance.

Specify currentness: the graph is identified by snapshot and content digests, CURRENT needs authoritative snapshot match, and stale or unverifiable graphs fail closed through the delivered SourceCatalog.

Ground the design in executed probe evidence and BB-062 experiments without adopting a graph database, and produce an exact file-level plan, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Adopt Oracle facade for Backend/QA production context

Specify the equivalent QA path mapping requiredArtifacts with producer/revision/acceptance provenance through the exact artifact provider, including the manifest-validating reader, to the unchanged QaContextSchema.

Specify fail-closed behavior: UNSATISFIED, PARTIAL for required declared files, stale, provenance mismatch or budget exhaustion block Worker execution exactly as the compatibility path does, and the default path is byte-identical in behavior.
Produce an exact file-level plan with equivalence tests between compatibility and Oracle paths, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Bind declared negative cases to executed subject-invoking tests in the Worker gate
expectedOutputs: Specify a typed negativeCaseBindings plan contract mapping every negativeVerificationCases entry to criterion, verification run, exact test title and subject symbol, validated deterministically at readiness and worker start.

Specify deterministic evidence collection that fails when a bound test title is absent or not passing in its verification log (spec and TAP formats), when its extracted body does not invoke the subject symbol, or when it contains an always-true assertion.
Specify one atomic Worker Jev question per binding carrying the extracted test body, with a no-retrofit policy threshold and unchanged confidence-as-telemetry policy.

Ground the design in the executed BB-064 root-cause probe and produce an exact file-level plan, regression fixtures reproducing the BB-064 shape, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Research and ablate retrieval planner strategies
expectedOutputs: Specify a discriminating ablation harness over a frozen snapshot corpus and ground truth executed through the real planner and providers, which reports INCONCLUSIVE when arms are not discriminating.
Specify opt-in GRAPH_EXPANDED_V1 and RRF_FUSION_V1 planning strategies that keep reservation, EXACT/CURRENT, provenance and budget semantics identical to DETERMINISTIC_V1.
Specify a preregistered per-query non-inferiority decision returning RECOMMEND_<strategy> or KEEP_DETERMINISTIC_V1 without changing defaults, with model-assisted planning explicitly NOT_EVALUATED.
Ground the design in the executed continuation probe and produce an exact file-level plan, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Implement bounded explicit progressive resolution
expectedOutputs: Specify resolveNext(requirement, previous) on the facade producing step index+1 bound to previous.resolutionId, re-attempting only evidence with retriable unresolved reasons under the remaining cumulative budget.
Specify no hidden growth: previous items retained byte-identical, new items only for previously unresolved evidence, requirement identity unchanged and consumption monotonic within budget.
Specify termination and currentness: reject when complete, out of steps or nothing retriable; re-fence all evidence and fail progression when a previously resolved source changed.
Ground the design in the executed progression probe and produce an exact file-level plan, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Implement model-aware context budget profiles
expectedOutputs: Specify CONTEXT_BUDGET_PROFILE_V1 keyed by model profile identity with rendered-character ceiling, reserved characters and optional exact tokenizer, and deterministic derivation of ContextRequirement.budget.
Specify a render-fit guarantee: derived maxMaterializedBytes plus measured Core block envelope never exceeds the Core rendered-size limit, verified against resolveContextRequirementBlocks rendering.
Specify adaptive next-step budgets for progressive resolution and preservation of source identity by dropping whole items rather than truncating content.
Produce an exact file-level plan, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Verify Oracle on supported Core execution profiles
expectedOutputs: Specify a conformance suite resolving Oracle requirement blocks through Core createAgentRuntime on CORE_SYNC and, only when published, CORE_ASYNC_FIRST_V1, with fail-closed pre-render behavior per profile.
Specify the async rule: a resolution is pinned to one agent call; a wake/resume performs a new call that re-resolves or reuses only a CURRENT receipt, never a STALE one.
Specify the frozen ORACLE_CORE_INTERACTION_V1 protocol (2x2 when async is published, otherwise 1x2 with async NOT_EVALUATED) reusing ORACLE_CONTEXT_BENCHMARK_V1 fixed factors, validated offline.
Produce an exact file-level plan, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Accept Oracle profile on held-out fixed-factor benchmark

Specify a preregistered conjunctive gate with per-task quality non-inferiority, zero provenance/currentness violations and prompt-input/cost ceilings, where UNKNOWN required measurements yield INCONCLUSIVE.
Specify a deterministic reducer returning PUBLISH_ORACLE_PROFILE_V1, KEEP_FOUNDATION or INCONCLUSIVE, publication only on PUBLISH, and registration of every unit/attempt through @exharness/benchmark.
Produce an exact file-level plan, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Bind delivered Backend/QA acceptance to a real repository and real verification processes
expectedOutputs: Specify a real local git workspace adapter whose ACT commits declared edits in an isolated detached worktree, carries the commit sha as candidate.version, rejects unsafe paths and no-op edits, and never changes the source repository HEAD or working tree.

Specify a real local command verifier that executes an argument-array process without a shell, is PASS only on exit 0, fails on revision mismatch or post-run tree mutation, terminates the process tree on timeout as INCONCLUSIVE, and binds evidence to the evaluated commit.

Specify an end-to-end proof that the delivered BackendWorker driven by a real Core CodeAct strategy with a deterministic model reaches ACCEPT only when the real commit makes the real test pass, and never ACCEPTs the executed probe shape (no or unrelated edit, failing test).

Specify an end-to-end proof that the delivered QaWorker verifies the accepted Backend commit through real command verifiers on a read-only checkout and fails when QA mutates the checkout or verifies a different revision.

Ground the design in the executed BB-096 probe, correct README and Living agentic docs so injected fixtures are distinguished from delivered local adapters, and produce an exact file-level plan, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Run Codex, Kiro and agy under ExHarness supervision
expectedOutputs: Specify tool adapters for Codex, Kiro and agy that build exact shell-free non-interactive and resume invocations with explicit permission profiles, resolve Windows npm shims without cmd.exe, and report an unavailable tool as TOOL_UNAVAILABLE.
Specify one bounded process runner that captures bounded output with digests, redacts nothing it does not own, and terminates the whole process tree on timeout.

Specify an ExHarness-supervised loop on Core createHarness and the BB-096 workspace/verifiers where each agent invocation is an ACT candidate, only passing declared verification can PROMOTE, failures feed back through tool resume up to maxAttempts, agent commits are folded into one candidate and the agent claim is telemetry only.
Specify a CLI entrypoint and an opt-in live smoke that never fakes success when a tool is missing or unauthenticated, plus Living docs stating the no-sandbox trust boundary.
Ground the design in the executed agent CLI probe and produce an exact file-level plan, fake-CLI fixtures, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Observe supervised and direct agent-tool runs

Specify per-tool output parsers that report token usage only when the tool reports it and otherwise record null with an explicit unavailable reason, never an estimate.
Specify secret redaction applied before any trace byte is written, proven by a planted-secret test.
Specify a deterministic descriptive report per tool and arm that never asserts acceptance or value, plus Living docs.
Ground the design in the executed agent CLI probe and delivered Core observability and produce an exact file-level plan, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Measure ExHarness-supervised versus direct agent-tool delivery
expectedOutputs: Specify an owned local suite of calibrated agent tasks whose hidden acceptance tests are stored outside the agent worktree and applied only at independent evaluation.
Specify DIRECT_SINGLE, DIRECT_RETRY and EXHARNESS_SUPERVISED arms with matched per-tool fixed factors and attempt budget, and a pre-registration whose digest the runner enforces before any attempt.

Specify execution through the BB-065 benchmark public API with BB-098 traces as evidence, independent hidden-test evaluation, and a deterministic seeded paired-bootstrap reducer producing per-tool SUPERIOR, INFERIOR or INCONCLUSIVE with false-success, time, invocation and token metrics.

Specify a deterministic calibration over fake CLIs that reproduces the expected verdicts, and an opt-in cost-capped live pilot that records NOT_EVALUATED instead of fabricating results when a tool is unavailable.

Ground the design in the executed agent CLI probe and the planned benchmark, supervision and observation contracts and produce an exact file-level plan, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Compose supervised agent-tools as an opt-in Backend adapter
expectedOutputs: Specify an opt-in adapter that maps BackendWorkOrder plus BackendContext to AGENT_TASK_V1, runs the delivered supervised loop, and projects AGENT_SUPERVISED_RESULT_V1 onto BackendWorkResultSchema with grounded mutation/typecheck/tests evidence at the accepted commit.
Specify fail-closed behavior: TOOL_UNAVAILABLE, EXHAUSTED, NO_CHANGE and failed verification cannot produce APPLIED; the default createBackendWorker path never constructs agent-tools objects.
Specify that agent claimedSuccess is telemetry only and that ExHarness git operations preserve the source repository HEAD, branch refs and working tree.
Specify Living docs distinguishing the opt-in supervised Backend path from the default CodeAct path and from BB-066 OpenHands domain runtime.
Ground the design in the executed productization probe and produce an exact file-level plan, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Resume a supervised agent-tool run after process death
expectedOutputs: Specify a durable AGENT_TOOL_RUN_HANDLE_V1 recording task id, worktree path, base revision, candidate sha, Core sessionId, tool id/version, tool sessionRef, attempt index and handle digest.

Specify crash-after-ACT resume that reopens the same worktree, resumes the tool session when the adapter supports it, continues the same Core session, and never creates a second candidate lineage for that handle.
Specify fail-closed behavior: missing worktree, digest mismatch, source HEAD drift, or a newer handle for the same task id refuses resume rather than starting a fresh mkdtemp run.
Specify that an unrecovered default run still disposes its worktree, plus Living docs for the recovery contract.
Ground the design in the executed productization probe and Core effect-journal behavior and produce an exact file-level plan, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Resolve declared agent-tool files through the Oracle facade
expectedOutputs: Specify an optional AGENT_TASK requiredFiles list mapped to an EXACT ContextRequirement at baseRevision and resolved through createOracleContextResolver.
Specify projection of consumable items into the agent prompt or workspace as grounded excerpts with sourceRef, without copying Oracle internals into the tool adapter.
Specify fail-closed behavior: missing file, stale snapshot, budget exhaustion or a path outside the worktree blocks before spawn; tasks without requiredFiles never construct an Oracle catalog.
Specify Living docs for the agent-tools Oracle consumer, distinct from BB-089 Backend/QA adoption.
Ground the design in the executed productization probe and the delivered Oracle facade and produce an exact file-level plan, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.

tasks.title: Expose verification and status as stdio MCP tools
expectedOutputs: Specify a stdio MCP server that exposes exharness_verify (run declared command verifiers at the current worktree HEAD) and exharness_status (attempt index, last verification, candidate sha) with typed JSON results.
